name: Frostline
summary: Revenue analytics for a subscription SaaS in frosted navy glass, with a comet on the MRR line
about: A complete revenue analytics app for a subscription software company, built from frosted glass panels over soft streaks of blue light, with a frosted daylight theme too. Daily MRR, plans, churn, cohort retention, customers and invoices all come from one list of subscriptions, so a price change or a cancellation moves every chart. It ships with sample data for a made-up note-taking app.
how: Switch 30D, 90D or 1Y on Overview: the MRR line morphs and a glowing comet runs along it. Payments arrive live in the side panel.
Revenue shows MRR stacked by plan, monthly movements, ARR against your goal and a month table; export the daily MRR as CSV.
Retention has a cohort heatmap by accounts or revenue, churn rates and who left this month.
Plans lets you change a price for new sign-ups only, or move current accounts to it today and watch MRR change.
Customers opens a drawer per subscription to change plan or seats, cancel with undo, or reactivate.
Invoices has status chips plus mark paid, retry, reminder, refund and download. Settings switches the theme and resets the demo.
